reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, as friction stir processing is known to refine grains and solute segregation can stabilize boundaries, but the assumption that a single-phase Ti-Ni-based HEA will remain single-phase and not form detrimental intermetallics during high-temperature processing and testing is a notable gap.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on a 10% improvement in mechanical properties and microstructural checks, though the specific FSP parameters are not given.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is useful as it proposes a practical thermomechanical route to improve high-temperature properties of a relatively unexplored HEA class, directly addressing the research question.
